RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel reflects poor diversity governance and increases the risk of unconscious affinity bias, but it is not definitive proof of discrimination. In senior banking roles, regulatory relationships are often heavily weighted, which may legitimately explain why the successful candidate was selected over someone with deeper technical quantitative modelling experience.

Do not raise the panel’s gender composition yet if your priority is receiving constructive feedback or preserving professional relationships, as it will likely be perceived as an accusation. First, follow up on your requested explanation. However, if the bank refuses to provide objective criteria or you choose to file a formal discrimination complaint, the panel's gender composition serves as relevant supporting context.
